_note: Project-specific dictionary for the understanding module. Format: term -> [definition, usage]. Terms from this project's prompts and memory files. Sibling: dictionary_core.json.

agent portal.definition: the multi-agent chat system agents talk through
agent portal.usage: route every prompt through the agent portal

pre-context.definition: background assembled before the main LLM prompt is built
pre-context.usage: fold dictionary meanings into pre-context first

readmem.definition: tool that reads memory files into the current context

storemem.definition: tool that writes new facts back into memory files

mirror.definition: the git-tracked sync of allowlisted files between host and sandbox
mirror.usage: memory_mirror.py pushes the allowlist over SMB

pin.definition: a fixed reference point (commit or state) used for comparison
pin.usage: correct the canonical pin before measuring drift

epoch.definition: a numbered period of a running system's life
epoch.usage: compare events across the epoch boundary

sla.definition: a service-level agreement: a deadline with a pass condition
sla.usage: check goal 8 against its SLA clock

goal ledger.definition: the jsonl record of goals plus evidence for each
goal ledger.usage: append one evidence line per completed step

cross-talk.definition: one agent answering or reacting to another agent's message
cross-talk.usage: suppress cross-talk with the SILENT convention

silent.definition: a marker meaning an agent posts nothing this turn
silent.usage: reply SILENT when no action is needed

scribe.definition: the agent role that keeps memory files current
scribe.usage: have scribe land the health note

archivist.definition: the agent role that audits and preserves records

mechanic.definition: the agent role that builds and repairs tooling

orchestrator.definition: the component coordinating which agents run when
orchestrator.usage: the orchestrator assigns turns across seats

verifier.definition: the agent role that checks claims against evidence
verifier.usage: verifier re-runs the check before accepting it

designer.definition: the agent role that plans structure and interfaces
designer.usage: designer drafts the schema, mechanic implements it

builder.definition: the agent role that assembles deliverables to spec

rag prefetch.definition: fetching likely-relevant memory chunks before a prompt is sent
rag prefetch.usage: key terms seed the rag prefetch lookup

background queue.definition: a list of long-running goals run away from the main loop
background queue.usage: move scheduled goals to the background queue

run rules.definition: rules every agent reads at the start of each run

blocker.definition: an open item that stops a goal until cleared

stall.definition: a goal making no progress across recent commits
stall.usage: flag stalls after 14 commits without change

turn.definition: one agent pass over one prompt, with its sandbox
turn.usage: each chat turn gets a fresh sandbox

sandbox.definition: the isolated environment where an agent's tools run
sandbox.usage: files in the sandbox mirror to the host

rdp.definition: remote desktop protocol for reaching Windows hosts here
rdp.usage: all RDP passwords are empty on these hosts

allowlist.definition: the list of files permitted to be mirrored
allowlist.usage: add new memory files to the allowlist

splice.definition: insert new code at an exact anchor in an existing file

degrade.definition: fall back to safe behavior instead of failing hard
degrade.usage: the module degrades to empty strings on error

key term.definition: a content word extracted from a prompt for lookup
key term.usage: expand each key term with synonyms
